blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified StakedUSDf exposes setRestrictedStatus and redistributeLockedAmount to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Deposits and withdrawals reject restricted caller, receiver and owner; administrators can burn or transfer restricted shares to TREASURY. The current transparent-proxy upgrade path can also replace token logic. Parent USDf transfer/compliance controls remain inherited.

oracleRisk.summary: Native sUSDf mint/redemption conversion uses onchain USDf balances less unvested rewards, not an external feed. Falcon nevertheless publishes live Chainlink-style sUSDf/USDf (0xe471bc940aa9831a0aea21e6f40c1a1236eb4bb3) and USDf/USD (0xb177857a1799aa5f7feb5799fdf12cbe8fdf78b1) aggregators. At Ethereum block 26110183 (2026-10-03T07:01:47Z), latestRoundData answers were 1137020080288662207 (18dp, updatedAt 1791002603) and 99705919 (8dp, updatedAt 1790953859). These informational/market integrations do not set the native unwrap rate; no borrower-liquidation branch exists in the exact savings implementation.

branchApplicability.rationale: The ERC-4626 share-to-underlying exchange rate is the top-level mint/redemption authority. There are no borrower-owned collateral branches on the savings token.
